pitch:
# A kanban board for a small team

## 1. People and their journey
**Team member** (the only role). Needs to see what work exists, which stage each item is in, and who is doing it.
Path: open the board, scan the columns, create a card in a column, fill in title and description, assign it to teammates, drag it to the next column as work progresses, edit or delete it when done.

## 2. How it looks
A kanban board as people picture it: a pale blue-grey backdrop with a horizontal row of tall, light grey columns, each holding a vertical stack of white cards.

- **Page backdrop**: fills the window, flat blue-grey (#DDE3EA), with the board filling the space below the header.
- **Header bar**: top, full width, flat dark navy (#1F2A44), white board name at left, member avatars at right.
- **Member avatars**: small circles in the header; each has its own fixed colour (blue, green, orange, purple, red, teal) with white initials. Hover shows the full name.
- **Column row**: below the header, scrolls sideways when columns overflow; columns sit left to right in workflow order with 12px gaps.
- **Column**: flat light grey (#EBECF0) rounded panel, fixed width 280px. While a card hovers over it while dragging, it turns slightly darker (#DFE1E6).
- **Column header**: top of column, bold dark-grey stage name and a card count in a small grey pill.
- **Card list**: inside the column, vertical stack of cards, scrolls within the column when long. Empty column shows the faint text "No cards".
- **Card**: white, raised with a soft shadow, rounded; shows bold title, then one line of description in grey, then assignee avatars at the bottom right. Hover: stronger shadow. Dragged: tilted slightly, with a larger shadow, and its original spot shows as a dashed grey outline.
- **Add card button**: bottom of each column, flat text button "+ Add card" in grey; hover gives a darker grey background.
- **New card form**: replaces the button; a white title box with Add (blue #2F6FDE) and Cancel buttons. An empty title leaves Add greyed out.
- **Card dialog**: centred white raised panel over a 50% black dim layer, with an editable title, description box, assignee checklist with avatars, Delete (red) and Close. Opens when a card is clicked.
- **Delete confirmation**: small dialog with the text "Delete this card?", a red Delete button and a Cancel button.

## 3. How it is used
- Click "+ Add card" in a column: the form opens at the bottom of that column.
- Type a title and press Enter or click Add: the card is created at the bottom of the column.
- Press Escape or click Cancel: the form closes and nothing is created.
- Click a card: the card dialog opens.
- Edit the title or description in the dialog: changes save when the field loses focus.
- Tick or untick a member in the dialog: assigns or unassigns them.
- Drag a card (mouse), or press and hold then drag (finger), to another column or a new spot in its own column: the card drops there and the others shift.
- Click Delete in the dialog, then confirm: the card is removed.
- Click a column's name: edit the name in place; Enter saves.
- Click "+ Add column" at the row's end: a new column is added at the end, ready for a name.
- Drag a column header sideways: reorders columns.
- Click a column's delete mark (shown only when the column is empty): removes the column.

## 4. Scope
One board per team, with ordered columns (new boards start with To do, In progress, Done) and cards. Team members create, edit, assign, move and delete cards, and manage the columns. Excluded: outside user access, billing, reports and integrations.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Board**: name, ordered columns.
- **Column**: name, position, ordered cards. It is either empty or holding cards.
- **Card**: title, description, assignees, column, position. It is moved by dragging, and ends when deleted.
- **Team member**: name, avatar colour. Members are fixed and assigned to cards.

## 6. Rules
- A card title is required; an empty title is refused and the previous title kept.
- A description is optional.
- A card sits in exactly one column at one position.
- A card has zero or more assignees, with each member counted once.
- A drop outside any column returns the card to its origin.
- Moving a card renumbers the positions in both columns.
- A column that holds cards cannot be deleted; the attempt is refused with the message "Move or delete its cards first".
- A column name is required and must be unique on the board; otherwise the edit is refused.
- Deleting a card needs confirmation; cancelling changes nothing.
- The last remaining column cannot be deleted.

entities_block: - **Board** (created by audience): [id: string, name: string, columns: list of Column {id: string, name: string, position: int, cards: list of Card {id: string, title: string, description: string, position: int}}, team_members: list of TeamMember {id: string, name: string, avatar_colour: string}]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Board starts with default columns] (Board): Given a new board is created When the board is initialised Then it contains the columns To do, In progress and Done in that order
- [Card title is required] (Board): Given a card with title 'Fix login' When the user saves an empty title Then the save is refused and the title remains 'Fix login'
- [Card title required on creation] (Board): Given the new card form is open with an empty title When the user attempts to add the card Then no card is created and the Add action stays disabled
- [Description is optional] (Board): Given a card with a title When the description is left empty and saved Then the card is saved with no description
- [Card created at column bottom] (Board): Given a column holding 2 cards When a user adds a card titled 'Write spec' Then the card is placed at position 3 in that column
- [Cancelling card creation creates nothing] (Board): Given the new card form is open with a typed title When the user presses Escape or clicks Cancel Then the form closes and no card is created
- [Card exists in exactly one column and position] (Board): Given a card in column 'To do' at position 1 When the card is viewed Then it belongs to exactly one column at exactly one position
- [Card may have multiple unique assignees] (Board): Given a card with no assignees When a member is assigned twice Then the card has zero or more assignees with that member counted once
- [Unassigning a member] (Board): Given a card assigned to Ana When Ana is unticked in the card dialog Then Ana is no longer an assignee of the card
- [Card edits save on field blur] (Board): Given a card dialog with an edited description When the description field loses focus Then the new description is saved to the card
- [Move card to another column] (Board): Given card A at position 2 in 'To do' and 'In progress' holds 2 cards When A is dropped in 'In progress' at position 1 Then A is in 'In progress' at position 1, the other cards shift, and 'To do' positions are renumbered
- [Reorder card within its column] (Board): Given cards A, B, C in one column When A is dropped after C Then the order is B, C, A with positions 1, 2, 3
- [Drop outside any column returns card] (Board): Given card A at position 2 in 'To do' When A is dropped outside any column Then A returns to 'To do' at position 2
- [Delete card requires confirmation] (Board): Given a card dialog with Delete clicked When the user cancels the confirmation Then the card remains unchanged
- [Confirmed card deletion] (Board): Given cards A, B, C in a column When B is deleted after confirmation Then only A and C remain with positions 1 and 2
- [Column name is required] (Board): Given a column named 'Review' When the user saves an empty name Then the edit is refused and the name remains 'Review'
- [Column name must be unique] (Board): Given a board with a column 'Done' When the user renames another column to 'Done' Then the edit is refused and the original name is kept
- [Column rename saves on Enter] (Board): Given a column name is being edited to 'Testing' When the user presses Enter Then the column is named 'Testing'
- [Add column at row end] (Board): Given a board with 3 columns When the user adds a column Then the new column is at position 4
- [Reorder columns by dragging header] (Board): Given columns To do, In progress, Done When 'Done' is dragged before 'To do' Then the order is Done, To do, In progress with positions 1, 2, 3
- [Column with cards cannot be deleted] (Board): Given column 'In progress' holds one card When the user attempts to delete the column Then the deletion is refused with the message 'Move or delete its cards first' and the column remains
- [Empty column can be deleted] (Board): Given column 'Backlog' holds no cards When the user deletes the column Then the column is removed and remaining columns are renumbered
- [Last remaining column cannot be deleted] (Board): Given a board with only one empty column When the user deletes it Then the deletion is refused and the column remains
- [Team members are fixed] (Board): Given the board's team members When a user attempts to add a new member Then no member is created and the fixed set is unchanged
- [Column card count display] (Board): Given a column holding 4 cards When the board is shown Then the column header shows the count 4
- [Empty column placeholder] (Board): Given a column with no cards When the board is shown Then the column displays 'No cards'
- [Column delete mark visibility] (Board): Given a column holding cards When the column is shown Then no delete mark is displayed
- [Drop target highlight] (Board): Given a card is being dragged When it hovers over a column Then the column background changes to #DFE1E6
intent_block:
- Product type: internal_tool
- Audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
- Goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
- Scope: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
- The model must cover: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages); cards representing work items, with title and description; team members and card assignment; card position and movement between columns
- Do NOT model: customer or external user access; billing or subscription management; reporting or analytics dashboards; integrations with other tools
